m6ControlledActivation.head: b23dfc0eb1eb07ad3fd85fe89399c7fb5e40c5c0
m6ControlledActivation.contract: controlled straight/right/left production crossings are default-off, preserve fixed pool and stable token/slot, report zero teleports, survive camera movement during connector crossing, and leave default laneAuthority authored-local-lanes

m7JunctionReservation.head: dcb08288ea797e7016bcdb3858299a85549a7259
m7JunctionReservation.contract: conflicting compiler-route tokens reserve before connector entry, wait on the incoming lane, normally clear once inside, release on exit/forced controlled stop, recover stale ownership deterministically, preserve fixed pool/identity and keep default civilian authority on authored local lanes

m8MultiAgentRuntime.head: 9173732803b2b92b28cf26a784e2382169eacc63
m8MultiAgentRuntime.contract: deterministic macro-population provenance seeds stable multi-agent compiler-route tokens; local progression uses compiler lanes/connectors only, conflicting agents share M7 reservations, routeActive pose is guarded from legacy behavior/steering, teardown releases reservations, fixed pool semantics remain intact, macro flows are not mutated and production default traffic remains authored-local-lanes

m8BrowserSoak.head: e9593957fff711e5b606253049321475376cccf8
m8BrowserSoak.contract: production browser data passes an explicit multi-agent compiler-route soak with compiler geometry validation, bounded per-tick movement, stable route token and materialization slot, fixed pool identity/size, live camera/stream movement, route-active presentation guards, bounded reservation telemetry with zero ownership after stop, unchanged isolated macro flows and clean restoration to authored-local-lanes; default startup remains unchanged

nextTask.goal: Make the validated multi-agent compiler-route runtime the normal civilian continuity path and migrate live aggregate civilian traffic accounting away from advancing legacy edge phases, without allowing compatibility state to regain local geometry authority.
actions: Audit every live consumer of MacroTrafficPoliceSystem civilian traffic phases/load before changing default ownership; police macro travel remains independent and must not regress.
Integrate the M8 multi-agent runtime with the normal production update loop using real frame delta so compiler route agents advance without a manual debug step API.

Flip normal civilian materialization/movement authority to the compiler-route runtime only after production bootstrap proves full seed coverage; explicit unseeded production tokens are a blocker for the default flip rather than silently disappearing.
Stop advancing legacy civilian edge phases as physical continuity state once compiler routes own normal movement; retain only the minimum bootstrap/compatibility records needed until M9 cleanup.

Feed live aggregate civilian district/load diagnostics from the conservative route compatibility projection while preserving total population and reporting ambiguous/unmatched projection explicitly rather than guessing.

Update laneAuthority/diagnostics so normal startup truthfully reports compiler-route ownership; keep macro centres/phases non-geometric and keep controlled-route debug proof available only as a regression harness.
Preserve fixed materialization pool, stable token/slot identity, lifecycle/hijack forced exits, reservation cleanup and route-active behavior/steering guards under normal gameplay updates.
Add default-startup browser coverage plus macro/police/vehicle regression coverage and run full CI before declaring M8 complete.
